offering_description.value: Builds and maintains infrastructure for utilities, communications and energy customers. Work includes pipelines, power transmission and distribution, wireless and wireline networks, renewable and clean energy plants, and heavy civil projects. Delivered with its own crews and equipment under contracts.

primary_services.value: pipeline construction; power line construction; communications network installation; clean energy project construction; heavy civil construction

customer_segment.value: B2B: utilities, telecom carriers, pipeline operators, energy and renewable developers, industrial firms; B2G: state transportation agencies and public infrastructure owners

end_markets.value: electric utilities; communications; oil and gas pipelines; renewable energy; civil infrastructure

revenue_model.value: project or contract: fixed-price, unit-price and cost-plus construction contracts; service fees: master service agreements for ongoing maintenance and installation work

value_chain_position.value: service provider: contractor using labor, materials and equipment to build infrastructure for utilities, carriers and energy firms

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, with some other international work

specialization.value: related lines: communications, clean energy and infrastructure, power delivery, and pipeline infrastructure construction

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: bids and long-term agreements directly with utilities, carriers and energy companies

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: construction safety (OSHA), environmental permitting, pipeline safety (PHMSA) and contractor licensing rules
